input.quote: Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties.
input.rationale: Searches for "compet", "exclusiv" and "shall not" across the single-section agreement turn up no non-compete, field-of-use or territory restriction binding AP. To the contrary, Section 1 (p0001) expressly disclaims exclusivity and confirms the Agreement will not restrict Customer from offering Inventory via other agents or selling Inventory to third parties. The only "shall not" covenants on Customer relate to Creative/content standards and prohibited ad categories, not to competing lines of business. This meets the preferred position (no restriction on Customer) and benefits our party, so no redline is warranted.
